<answer>

## Build system
Single root `CMakeLists.txt` (no nested CMake files), `cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16.3)` (:1), `project(EternalTCP VERSION 7.0.0)` (:114), C++20 required (:250-251). Two dependency modes:
- **vcpkg mode (default)**: toolchain `external/vcpkg/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake` (:56-59), manifest `vcpkg.json`, triplet auto-selected (:60-101: `x64-linux`/`arm64-linux`/`x64-osx`/`arm64-osx`/`x64-windows-static`).
- **DISABLE_VCPKG=ON**: system packages; adds submodules `external/Catch2` (if BUILD_TESTING), `external/cxxopts`, `external/cpp-httplib`, `external/json` via `add_subdirectory` (:136-148) and header-includes `external/simpleini`.

Required `find_package` (:127-133): ZLIB, OpenSSL, **Sanitizers (REQUIRED — from external/sanitizers-cmake, needed even for plain builds)**, Threads, sodium, Protobuf, optional Unwind (:133), optional UTempter (:161), SELinux only `if(LINUX)` (:163-165). Protobuf >= 4 additionally requires `absl` + `utf8_range` CONFIG packages (:277-283) — on Ubuntu: `libabsl-dev`, `libutf8-range-dev`. Sentry: on unless `DISABLE_SENTRY`/`DISABLE_TELEMETRY`/BSD (:181-198); CI always passes `-DDISABLE_TELEMETRY=ON`.

## Generated protobuf
`protobuf_generate_cpp` at :304 (`proto/ET.proto` → `ET.pb.{h,cc}`) and :306 (`proto/ETerminal.proto` → `ETerminal.pb.{h,cc}`), output in `CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR` (build root), custom target `generated-code` (:309-310). Both protos are proto2, package `et`, `optimize_for = LITE_RUNTIME` but link full `protobuf::libprotobuf` (:275).

## Binary targets
| Target | Line | Source | Platform |
|---|---|---|---|
| `et-lib` (static) | :408 | src/base/* + ET.pb | all |
| `TerminalCommon` (static) | :455 | src/terminal/* + ETerminal.pb | all |
| `et` (client) | :484 | src/terminal/TerminalClientMain.cpp | all (only binary on WIN32, :499-506) |
| `etserver` | :508 | src/terminal/TerminalServerMain.cpp | non-Windows |
| `etterminal` | :524 | src/terminal/TerminalMain.cpp | non-Windows |
| `HtmCommon` (static) | :540 | src/htm/* | non-Windows |
| `htm` | :553 | src/htm/HtmClientMain.cpp | non-Windows |
| `htmd` | :568 | src/htm/HtmServerMain.cpp | non-Windows |
| `et-test` | :590 | `file(GLOB test/**/*Test.cpp)` + test/Main.cpp | non-Windows, BUILD_TESTING (default ON, :116) |
| `TerminalServerFuzzer` | :629-631 | `test/TerminalServerFuzzer.cpp` | FUZZING only — **path broken, see flags** |
| `TerminalServerRouterFuzzer` | :648-650 | `test/TerminalServerRouterFuzzer.cpp` | FUZZING only — **path broken** |

Install: `etserver etterminal et htm htmd` → `bin` (:668-677); bash/zsh completions (:680-700); CPack generators `STGZ;TGZ;TZ;DEB` (:712), DEB depends `libprotobuf-dev, libc6 (>=2.34), libgcc-s1, libstdc++6 (>=12), libutempter0` (:718); `systemctl/` → `/lib/systemd/system`, `etc/` → `/etc` (:716); debian postinst/postrm/prerm as control extra (:715).

## Test targets
`catch_discover_tests(et-test TEST_PREFIX "et-test." ... TIMEOUT 300)` (:615-622). Custom runner `test/Main.cpp` (sets up easylogging + temp log dir, `TelemetryService::create(false,...)`). Integration tests require passwordless pubkey SSH to `localhost:2222` (linux_ci.yml starts `sshd -p 2222`); system tests use ports 2223/2224. TSAN suppressions: `TSAN_OPTIONS="suppressions=../test/test_tsan.suppression"`.

## Coverage
- `coverage.sh`: configures `cov_build/` with `-DCODE_COVERAGE=ON -DDISABLE_TELEMETRY=ON -G Ninja`, runs `ctest --parallel`, then `lcov --capture` + filter (strips /usr/include, vcpkg_installed, external/, test/, proto/, `ET.pb*`, `ETerminal.pb*`) + `genhtml`. **Note: it does NOT pass `-DDISABLE_VCPKG=ON`, so it uses the vcpkg toolchain; `-DBUILD_TEST=ON -DBUILD_GTEST=ON` are no-op leftovers (real option is BUILD_TESTING).** Needs `lcov` installed.
- CMake support: `option(CODE_COVERAGE)` (:217) adds `-g --coverage` (:228-231).
- CI variant: `.github/workflows/codecov.yml` runs `./build/et-test` directly then lcov, uploads via codecov-action@v4. `codecov.yml` (repo root) sets 50% target and ignore list.

## Platform conditionals (CMakeLists.txt)
MSVC static runtime :42-44, :167-169; APPLE sysroot :46-51; vcpkg triplets :60-101; LINUX→SELinux :163-165; FreeBSD/NetBSD detection :170-177; Sentry off on BSD :192-198; APPLE<19→Boost.filesystem :184-190; WIN32 `SODIUM_STATIC` :237-239, UNICODE :264-267; UNIX debug flags :245-248; APPLE/FREEBSD libc++ trait :255-259; CORE_LIBRARIES per-platform :312-337 (Linux: httplib, cxxopts, nlohmann_json, OpenSSL::SSL/Crypto, ZLIB, util, resolv, atomic, conditional `stdc++fs` only if present :330-337 — already GCC-15-ready); WIN32 client-only install :499-506; default prefix `/usr` on non-Apple/non-Windows :292-296.

## Package/service files
`systemctl/et.service` (systemd), `etc/et.cfg` (port 2022), `debian/{postinst,postrm,prerm}` (CPack DEB), `deployment/debian_SOURCE/` (PPA: `rules` forces `-DDISABLE_VCPKG:BOOL=ON`, disables ctest), `rc.d/etserver` (FreeBSD), `init/launchd/homebrew.mxcl.et.plist` (macOS), `docker/Dockerfile.{client,server}` (bookworm-slim, external apt repo).

## Release workflows
`vcpkg_build_release.yml` / `novcpkg_build_release.yml` trigger on `release` branch, build with `-GNinja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo`, upload `et` client artifact. `deploy_ubuntu_ppa.yml` (workflow_dispatch): resolves tag `et-vX.Y.Z`, builds deb source packages per `distro-info --supported` Ubuntu series from `deployment/debian_SOURCE`, GPG-signs, `dput` to `ppa:jgmath2000/et`. Also `deploy_debian_repo.yml`, `deploy_archlinux_aur.yml`, `deploy_windows_winget.yml`.

## Commands likely to work on Ubuntu 26.04 (mirrors portability_ci.yml debian:stable + novcpkg)
```bash
# 0. Submodules are mandatory (external/ is empty in this copy) — needs network:
git submodule update --init --recursive

# 1. Deps (Ubuntu 26.04 names)
sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  build-essential cmake ninja-build pkg-config git curl zip unzip tar \
  libssl-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libunwind-dev libutempter-dev libsodium-dev \
  libprotobuf-dev protobuf-compiler libabsl-dev libutf8-range-dev \
  autoconf automake libtool libtool-bin

# 2. Configure (system-deps path; telemetry off as in all CI)
cmake -DDISABLE_TELEMETRY=ON -DDISABLE_VCPKG=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo \
      -S . -B build -GNinja

# 3. Build
cmake --build build --parallel "$(nproc)"

# 4. Tests — integration tests need passwordless sshd on localhost:2222 first
sudo mkdir -p /run/sshd && sudo /usr/sbin/sshd -p 2222   # + pubkey in authorized_keys
ctest --test-dir build --parallel "$(nproc)" --output-on-failure

# 5. Coverage (add -DDISABLE_VCPKG=ON; stock coverage.sh uses vcpkg)
sudo apt-get install -y lcov
cmake -DDISABLE_TELEMETRY=ON -DDISABLE_VCPKG=ON -DCODE_COVERAGE=ON -S . -B cov_build -G Ninja
cmake --build cov_build --parallel "$(nproc)"
ctest --test-dir cov_build --parallel --output-on-failure
lcov --directory cov_build --capture --output-file code-coverage.info -rc lcov_branch_coverage=1
```
Sanitizer variants (linux_ci.yml): add `-DSANITIZE_UNDEFINED=ON` / `-DSANITIZE_ADDRESS=ON` / `-DSANITIZE_MEMORY=ON` / `-DSANITIZE_THREAD=ON -DSANITIZE_LINK_STATIC=ON`.

## Flags — external dependencies unavailable locally / hazards
1. **All 16 submodules under `external/` are empty** in this copy (verified: vcpkg, Catch2, cxxopts, cpp-httplib, json, simpleini, easyloggingpp, PlatformFolders, ThreadPool, sole, base64, UniversalStacktrace, sanitizers-cmake, sentry-native all `(empty directory)`). No build mode works without `git submodule update --init --recursive` (network). Even a minimal DISABLE_VCPKG+DISABLE_TELEMETRY build needs: sanitizers-cmake (`find_package(Sanitizers REQUIRED)` :129), easyloggingpp, PlatformFolders, ThreadPool, sole, base64, UniversalStacktrace (include_directories :372-388), cxxopts, cpp-httplib, json, simpleini (:136-148), plus Catch2 if BUILD_TESTING.
2. **`-DFUZZING=ON` is broken upstream**: CMakeLists.txt:631 and :650 reference `test/TerminalServerFuzzer.cpp` / `test/TerminalServerRouterFuzzer.cpp`, but those files live at `test/integration_tests/TerminalServerFuzzer.cpp` and `test/integration_tests/TerminalServerRouterFuzzer.cpp` — configure/build will fail on missing sources.
3. **`test/HostParsingTest.cpp` is likely never compiled**: the glob `file(GLOB TEST_SRCS test/**/*Test.cpp)` (:589) is non-recursive; `**` without GLOB_RECURSE does not cross directories, so it matches `test/unit_tests/*` and `test/integration_tests/*` but not a file directly under `test/`. Verify with `ctest -N | grep -i host` after building.
4. **coverage.sh implicitly requires vcpkg** (no `-DDISABLE_VCPKG=ON`) and `lcov`; its `-DBUILD_TEST=ON -DBUILD_GTEST=ON` flags are no-ops.
5. **backwards_compatibility.sh** downloads the et-v7.0.0 release binary from GitHub (network at test time).
6. **Ubuntu 26.04/protobuf>=4**: must have `libabsl-dev` + `libutf8-range-dev` (:277-283); GCC 15 `stdc++fs` removal already handled (:330-337). `libboost-dev` is NOT needed on Linux (Boost only for pre-Mojave macOS, :184-190) despite novcpkg_build_master.yml installing it.
7. `build_static.sh` is obsolete (pins cmake 3.9.4, protobuf v3.4.1, libsodium 1.0.12) — do not use on 26.04.
8. `external/msgpack-c` and `external/cotire` are submodules but unreferenced by CMakeLists (vestigial; `git submodule update --init --recursive` still fetches them).
</answer>

<next_steps>
- To build here: run `git submodule update --init --recursive` in /tmp/eternalterminal-upstream.xhGJxy first (network required), then use the DISABLE_VCPKG command sequence above.
- If porting to a new repo: the minimal vendored set is the 12 submodules listed in flag #1 (skip msgpack-c/cotire), plus system packages from step 1.
- If fuzzing matters: fix CMakeLists.txt:631/:650 paths to `test/integration_tests/...` before enabling `-DFUZZING=ON`.
- Ready to proceed — no follow-up exploration needed.
</next_steps>
</results>
